'''Treeg''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Army|Army]] [[Major/Legends|major]] stationed on [[Quesh]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the key strategist and main aide of the [[General/Legends|General]] [[Korvan]].

Treeg disagreed with Korvan's approach to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] invasion of Quesh, which centered around the defense of the planet's venom mines and workers; Treeg believed that a direct assault would quickly end the invasion.
In the end, Korvan's tactics proved effective and the Empire's troops were routed; however Treeg was approached by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Magras]], and he decided to defect to the Empire so that his talent could be recognized. With his help, Magras captured [[Broga Masrii]], head of the [[Three Families]], but soon arrived a Republic individual that confronted them. To secure Treeg's loyalty, Magras injected him with a pure [[Venenit queshaaga|Quesh venom]], promising to give him the antidote after the republican will be defeated. Despite this, a Republic individual prevailed, defeated both Magras and Treeg and liberated the Hutt.
{{GameLS}}
Treeg was then arrested and put on trial for [[Treason/Legends|treason]].
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
After defeating Treeg, the player has an option to leave him or to die from [[Venenit queshaaga|Quesh venom]].
